name: Discover bricks
summary: Scan GitHub for reusable bricks (functions, workflows, Dockerfiles, schemas, modules), score them on license, stars, recency, path and size, and emit a ranked candidate-list.
snap: node toolkit/scanner/scan.js "<capability>" --lang <lang> --kind <kind> --out candidates.json [--emit-entries .forkbomb/drafts]; then node toolkit/process/cycle.js check .forkbomb/drafts.
